title: Etcd listens only on container loopback
root_cause: Etcd binds its client listener to loopback inside the service container, while the job reaches it through a published host port. Docker's forwarding reaches the container network interface rather than that loopback listener, so the connections are refused.

relevant_evidence.why: The health requests repeatedly receive connection refusals.
The service listens only on its container loopback and publishes the port.
The job connects through the host port.
